description: Cancel one of the signed-in customer's booking requests or bookings; this cannot be undone, so confirm with the customer first. A request that is still searching is withdrawn; a confirmed booking is cancelled under the cancellation terms shown by tolk2go_interpreting_preview_selection, so a late cancellation can be charged. Returns the booking_id with status cancelled, or an error when the booking cannot be cancelled (for example when it is already completed). The reason is optional.
name: tolk2go_interpreting_cancel_booking
title: Cancel a booking
